sites.first_line: This guide has been updated to include steps for removing support for React 16, as it is now deprecated.
sites.rule: `Backstage packages require React 18. React 17 is no longer supported, so you must complete this migration before you upgrade to a Backstage release that requires React 18.`

sites.first_line: The Backstage core libraries and plugins are compatible with all versions of React from v17 to v18. This means that you can migrate projects at your own pace. We do however encourage you to do so sooner rather than later, both to keep up with the evolving ecosystem, but also because React 18 brings performance improvements, in particular in tests.
sites.rule: One paragraph: the Backstage core libraries and plugins require React 18 and declare `^18.0.0` peer dependencies for `react`, `react-dom` and `@types/react`; this guide shows how to move an app and its plugins from React 17 to React 18; React 18 also brings performance improvements, in particular in tests.
Same indentation and commas, each value "^18.0.0".

behaviour: Breaking changeset for the 54 published packages whose React peer ranges now require React 18.
rules: Front matter, one line each in this order, `major`: '@backstage/app-defaults', '@backstage/core-app-api', '@backstage/core-plugin-api', '@backstage/dev-utils', '@backstage/integration-react', '@backstage/test-utils', '@backstage/version-bridge', '@backstage/plugin-catalog', '@backstage/plugin-catalog-react', '@backstage/plugin-scaffolder', '@backstage/plugin-scaffolder-react', '@backstage/plugin-search', '@backstage/plugin-search-react', '@backstage/plugin-techdocs', '@backstage/plugin-techdocs-addons-test-utils', '@backstage/plugin-techdocs-module-addons-contrib', '@backstage/plugin-techdocs-react'.

Body: `**BREAKING**: React 17 is no longer supported. These packages now require React 18, with `^18.0.0` peer dependency ranges for `react`, `react-dom` and `@types/react`. If your app still uses React 17, follow the [React 18 migration guide](https://backstage.io/docs/tutorials/react18-migration) before you upgrade.`

style_from.reason: Changeset front matter and body shape.

behaviour: Breaking changeset for the removed legacyRoot option of @backstage/test-utils.
rules: Body: `**BREAKING**: Removed the `legacyRoot` option and the `LegacyRootOption` type from `renderWithEffects` and `renderInTestApp`. Tests always render with the React 18 root; remove any `legacyRoot` option you pass to these helpers.`

behaviour: Changeset for the React 18 requirement in @backstage/cli-module-build.
rules: Body: `**BREAKING**: The frontend build and dev server now assume React 18 and no longer inject the build-time flag that reported whether `react-dom/client` is available. When the app you start resolves a React version older than 18, `package start` warns that Backstage requires React 18 and links the [React 18 migration guide](https://backstage.io/docs/tutorials/react18-migration).`

behaviour: Changeset for the dropped React 17 probe in @backstage/cli-module-test-jest.
rules: Body: `**BREAKING**: The Jest configuration now assumes React 18 and no longer sets the environment flag that reported whether `react-dom/client` is available.`

behaviour: Changeset for the React 18 only ranges of the yarn new templates.
rules: Body: `Frontend plugins, plugin web libraries and scaffolder field extension modules created with `yarn new` now declare React 18 only version ranges for `react` and `react-dom`.`

behaviour: Changeset for the single React 18 range enforced by the repo-tools peer-deps command.
rules: Body: `**BREAKING**: The `peer-deps` command now expects `^18.0.0` peer dependency ranges for `react`, `react-dom` and `@types/react` in every package, and reports packages that still allow React 17. Run it with `--fix` to update your packages.`

behaviour: Non-breaking changeset for @backstage/ui using React's built-in hooks.
rules: Body, no BREAKING prefix: `Uses the hooks built into React 18 instead of polyfills, and no longer depends on `use-sync-external-store`. The generated element ids that link popovers, tooltips, tables and table pagination to their labels and descriptions now use the React id format.`
